out_items.name: Proper eating, tasting, drinking, or tobacco use

violations.title: Eating, Drinking, or Using Tobacco
violations.observation: Open drinking containers used or stored in a manner that may contaminate food, food contact surfaces or utensils. Opened drinking cups containing beverage were observed on the cook-line tables.
violations.corrective_action: Food employees may have beverages in the kitchen areas as long as they are covered and consumed through a straw and stored in a manner that will prevent contamination to food, equipment, utensils, linens, and single service items. CORRECTED.

out_items.name: Hands clean and properly washed

violations.title: Where to Wash
violations.observation: A food employee was observed cleaning their hands in a food preparation sink/3-vat sink.
violations.corrective_action: ALL food employees shall wash their hands in ONLY a designated handsink. CORRECTED.

out_items.name: Food separated and protected

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal Foods Different Types
violations.observation: Different types of raw animal foods stored in such a manner that may cause cross contamination as follows: Raw meat, raw chicken, found stored above vegetables and cooked food items , in the walk-in Refrigerator
violations.corrective_action: Raw animal foods shall be sorted by their 'type' and cooking temperatures while in storage inside a refrigerator or freezer. For example, if using ONE shelving unit for storage of ONLY raw foods, the foods shall be sorted in this manner: 1) raw poultry (chicken, turkey, or duck) shall be stored on the BOTTOM shelf (165F cook temperature), 2) raw ground beef and ground pork shall be stored on the shelf above poultry (155F cook temperature), and 3) raw pork (chops, ribs), seafood, and shell eggs shall be stored on the top shelf above beef (145F cook temperature). CORRECTED DURING THE INSPECTION

violations.title: Cover Foods in Storage
violations.observation: Unwrapped or uncovered food in the following location where the food is subject to contamination: some of the food containers in the walk-in refrigeraor were not covered.
violations.corrective_action: Foods shall be protected from contamination by being stored in packages, covered containers or wrappings unless being cooled. CORRECTED.

violations.title: Separation of Clean and Soiled Equipment/Utensils
violations.observation: The following visibly soiled or improperly cleaned equipment or utensils were observed being used during food preparation: A soiled wet towel was observed placed on noodles, on the prep table. also, raw meat packs were placed. Next to cooked noodles on them prep table.
violations.corrective_action: Foods shall be prepared using only cleaned and sanitized equipment and utensils to prevent contamination to the foods being prepared. CORRECTED. Contaminated noodles write discarded during the inspection.

violations.title: Cover Foods in Storage
violations.observation: Unwrapped or uncovered food in the following location where the food is subject to contamination: walk-in refrigerator
violations.corrective_action: Foods shall be protected from contamination by being stored in packages, covered containers or wrappings unless being cooled. CORRECTED.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Signage
violations.observation: Observed that sign or poster that notifies food employees to wash their hands is not provided or is not clearly visible at all handwashing sinks used by food employees.
violations.corrective_action: Provide a visible sign or poster at all handwashing sinks used by food employees that reminds food employees to wash their hands.

out_items.name: Food separated and protected

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: raw chicken, seafood, raw meat were observed stored above cooked food and vegetables;es, inside the walk-in Refrtigerator
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc.

violations.title: Cover Foods in Storage
violations.observation: Unwrapped or uncovered food in the following location where the food is subject to contamination: walk-in refrigerator
violations.corrective_action: Foods shall be protected from contamination by being stored in packages, covered containers or wrappings unless being cooled.

out_items.name: Food-contact surfaces cleaned and sanitized

violations.title: Non-TCS Food Contact Surface, Clean after Use
violations.observation: Surfaces of the can open er and the badge holder, were in contact with non-time/temperature control for safety food items that were observed soiled with accumulations of grime and debris.
violations.corrective_action: Surfaces of utensils and equipment contacting food that is NOT time/temperature control for safety food shall be cleaned at any time when contamination may have occurred. CLEAN THE CAN OPENER AND THE BASE HOLDER FREQUENTLY TO PREVENT FOOD CONTAMINATION.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Common Name, Working Containers
violations.observation: Working containers of poisonous and toxic materials are not properly labeled with a common name. Unmarked spray bottles which contain toxic cleaning solutions were not observed labeled, to identify contents.
violations.corrective_action: Label all working containers of poisonous and toxic materials, including cleaners and sanitizers, with a common name to prevent the dangerous misuse of these materials.

out_items.name: Thermometers provided and accurate

violations.title: Thermometers, Location in Holding Units
violations.observation: The temperature measuring device in the following mechanically refrigerated unit was not properly located in the warmest part of the unit: Place a thermometer at the front warmest section of the fridge, for proper monitoring of the ambient air.
violations.corrective_action: In a mechanically refrigerated unit the sensor of a temperature measuring device shall be located to measure the air temperature of a simulated product temperature in the warmest part of the refrigerator. Store the thermometer near the door of the unit. MAMA CHANG (Inspection Date: 04/21/2026) Page 3 of 4

out_items.name: Food properly labeled, original container

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: Several liquids in squeeze bottles and spices such as sugar, salt, and powdered foods that are also not easy to identify, were not observed.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc.

out_items.name: Insects, rodents, and animals not present

violations.title: Openings Protected from Pest Entry
violations.observation: The back door entrance to the kitchen found kept open for ventilation and opening is not protected by a screen or other effective means.
violations.corrective_action: Provide screens (16 mesh to 1 inch), air curtains, or other effective means to protect against the entry of insects and rodents.

violations.title: Openings Protected from Pest Entry
violations.observation: Openings to the exterior of the building are present along the back door screen.
violations.corrective_action: Fill or close holes and other gaps along floors, walls, and ceilings to protect against the entry of insects and rodents.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Food stored on the floor and/or food stored less than 6 inches off the floor. Lots of food containers and boxers were found stored on the floor in the walk-in Refrigerator, walk-in Freezer, and in dry storage areas.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage.

out_items.name: In-use utensils properly stored

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: Several knives were found stored inbetween prep tables,some between tables and then walls.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, Design/Construction
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surface of the following equipment is not designed or constructed to be easily cleanable: Aluminum foil liners under prep tables , and are not being replaced frequently, are not easily cleanable.
violations.corrective_action: Non-food contact surfaces shall be free of unnecessary ledges, projections, and crevices, and designed and constructed to allow easy cleaning and to facilitate maintenance. You may remove the foil liners and maintain the surfaces of the table cleaned.

out_items.name: Garbage and refuse properly disposed, facilities maintained

violations.title: Receptacles, Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: The trash containers are north being maintained in clean condition.
violations.corrective_action: Clean the trash cans properly and frequently.

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: Observed that the storage wire shelving inside the walk-in refrigerator are very rusty and are not not maintained in good repair.
violations.corrective_action: Repair the physical facilities. Poor repair and maintenance compromises the functionality of the physical facilities. Resurface or replace there rusty shelves.

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: Observed that the wall, wall fixtures, inside the walk-in refrigerator is in need of cleaning. The vent above the duck storage, was observed to be dirty and in need of cleaning. The floor drains and the floor under thew dish washing machine , under the 3-Vat sink, and other equipment are in need of cleaning, The drain piping under the dish machine, ice machine, under the 3-vat sink are also in need of cleaning.
violations.corrective_action: Clean the physical facilities at a frequency necessary to ensure the protection and safe preparation of food.

out_items.name: Proper cold holding temperatures

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: Brussels sprout =66.1F
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. CORRTECTED DURING THE INS{ECTION.(discarded)

violations.title: Eggs Stored at 45F or less
violations.observation: Observed an ambient air temperature above 45F in the following refrigeration unit holding raw shells eggs: 51F
violations.corrective_action: Shell eggs that have not been treated to destroy Salmonella shall be stored in refrigerated equipment that maintains an ambient temperature of 45F or less. CORRECTED DURING THE INSPECTION. The eggs were discarded during the inspection.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Sanitizers, Criteria
violations.observation: The concentration of the CHLORINE solution at the 3-compartment sink was measured at above 200ppm. This concentration exceeds the approved limits for use with food-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils in a foodservice establishment.
violations.corrective_action: Maintain the concentration of 50ppm to below 200ppm in the solution. Verify concentration using the appropriate test kit. Corrected during the inspection.
